display.purpose: Screen headings. 28px in containers of at least 900×700.

title.purpose: Card headings and Takeover section titles. 18px in large containers.

label.purpose: Menu rows, buttons, Toasts, field labels. 13px in large containers.

caption.purpose: Slot indexes, counters, location captions, filenames. 11px in large containers.

editable.purpose: Minimum computed size of every editable control.

shadows.name: subtle
shadows.purpose: Slots, cards, and small chips at rest.

shadows.name: controller-focus
shadows.purpose: Shared focus ring in controller modality.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Menus that slide from an edge.

motion.name: route-in
motion.purpose: Incoming route view. Removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: micro
motion.purpose: Slot hover and press feedback; press scales to 0.97.

components.name: Slot (filled)
components.description: Type-tinted tray cell that frames one pixel sprite. The signature component.
components.css: .ds-slot { --slot-hue: 145; --slot-chroma: 0.09; position: relative; width: 64px; height: 64px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; background: oklch(0.9 var(--slot-chroma) var(--slot-hue)); box-shadow: var(--pksx-shadow-subtle); color: var(--pksx-color-text-primary); outline: 2px solid transparent; outline-offset: -2px; transition: transform 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease; } .ds-slot:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--pksx-color-accent-primary), var(--pksx-shadow-raised); } .ds-slot:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--pksx-color-accent-primary); } .ds-slot-index { position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 5px; font: 700 10px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.04em; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-slot-sprite { width: 60%; height: 60%; border-radius: 2px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pksx-color-text-primary), transparent 75%); }

components.name: Slot (dual type)
components.description: Two type tints split on a 135 degree diagonal at 55%.
components.css: .ds-slot-dual { width: 64px; height: 64px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(0.9 0.09 30) 0 55%, oklch(0.9 0.09 250) 55% 100%); box-shadow: var(--pksx-shadow-subtle); outline: 2px solid transparent; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-slot-dual:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--pksx-color-accent-primary); }

components.name: Slot (empty)
components.description: Recessed dashed cell; the dash turns solid Rust on focus.
components.css: .ds-slot-empty { width: 64px; height: 64px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1.5px dashed var(--pksx-color-border-strong); border-radius: 11px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pksx-color-surface-subtle), transparent 35%); } .ds-slot-empty span { width: 50%; height: 50%; border: 1.25px dashed var(--pksx-color-border-strong); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-slot-empty:focus-visible { border-style: solid; border-color: var(--pksx-color-accent-primary); outline: none; }

components.name: Menu row
components.description: Pressable, plain command row in a Menu. Rust wash on hover and focus.
components.css: .ds-menu-row { width: 220px; height: 28px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--pksx-color-surface-panel); color: var(--pksx-color-text-primary); font: 750 12px/1.15 var(--pksx-font-sans); transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-menu-row:hover, .ds-menu-row:focus-visible { background: var(--pksx-color-accent-wash); color: var(--pksx-color-accent-primary); outline: none; } .ds-menu-row:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Menu row (unavailable)
components.description: Unavailable command stays visible with its reason.
components.css: .ds-unavail { display: grid; gap: 1px; width: 220px; } .ds-unavail button { height: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--pksx-color-surface-subtle); color: var(--pksx-color-text-primary); font: 750 12px/1.15 var(--pksx-font-sans); opacity: 0.68; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-unavail span { color: var(--pksx-color-text-secondary); font: 600 10px/1.2 var(--pksx-font-sans); text-align: center; }

components.name: Primary action
components.description: The one filled Rust action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 220px; height: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--pksx-color-accent-primary); color: #fff; font: 750 12px/1.15 var(--pksx-font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: var(--pksx-color-accent-ring); outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Save File card
components.description: Tab-corner card: small leading radius, large trailing radius.
components.css: .ds-card { min-width: 240px; min-height: 112px; display: grid; align-content: start; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--pksx-color-border-subtle); border-radius: 4px 14px 14px 4px; background: var(--pksx-color-surface-panel); box-shadow: var(--pksx-shadow-subtle); color: var(--pksx-color-text-primary); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card strong { font: 800 16px/1.1 var(--pksx-font-sans); } .ds-card span { color: var(--pksx-color-text-muted); font: 650 10px/1.25 var(--pksx-font-mono); } .ds-card:hover { background: linear-gradient(var(--pksx-color-accent-wash), var(--pksx-color-accent-wash)), var(--pksx-color-surface-panel); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pksx-color-accent-ring); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Bottom-trailing notice with a colored status dot. Never takes focus.
components.css: .ds-toast { width: 320px; min-height: 42px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 9px 8px 9px 10px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--pksx-color-text-primary), transparent 88%); border-radius: 11px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pksx-color-surface-panel), white 8%); box-shadow: 0 18px 44px color-mix(in srgb, black, transparent 82%), 0 5px 14px color-mix(in srgb, black, transparent 88%); color: var(--pksx-color-text-primary); font: 700 12px/1.25 var(--pksx-font-sans); } .ds-toast-mark { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--pksx-color-feedback-success); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--pksx-color-feedback-success), transparent 84%); }

narrative.overview:
PKSX is a display case for a collection. Each Box is a tray, and each Slot is a small tinted cell that frames one specimen: a pixel sprite from the offline Sprite Catalog. Everything around the tray is quiet so that the Pokemon carry the color. The light theme is warm paper and dark ink with one rust accent. The dark theme is near-black with an ember accent. Both themes keep the same structure.

The mood is warm, tactile, and quiet. Surfaces feel like paper with a soft lift. A faint diagonal grain and two very soft radial washes give the canvas texture without pattern noise. Density follows the container, not the device: room grows with height, and the type scale stays fixed. The shell reserves no chrome, so the collection fills the Safe Canvas.

PKSX rejects the dense PKHeX-style desktop form. No screen is a wall of labelled fields. Editing happens in focused Takeovers, and the Box grid is always the home position.
keyCharacteristics: Type-tinted Slots are the main source of color. Chrome stays neutral.
One accent (Rust in light, Ember in dark) marks focus, the active item, and the primary action.
Mono numerals for indexes, levels, stats, captions, and filenames.
Soft structural shadows with a 1px inner highlight. No glows.
Fixed type ladder; spacing and control height scale with container height.
Every target is reachable by controller and shows a clear focus ring.

rules.name: The Specimen Color Rule
rules.body: Pokemon carry the color. Chrome uses neutrals and the one accent. Do not add decorative hues to panels, headers, or buttons.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Rust (or Ember) means "here" or "do this". If two things on screen are rust, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Readable Contrast Rule
rules.body: Every text token passes WCAG AA (4.5:1) on Parchment, Cream Paper, and Sunken Paper, and the dark equivalents. Text on a Rust or Ember fill uses On Rust or On Ember, never a fixed white.

rules.name: The Shared Token Rule
rules.body: Components read `--pksx-color-*` tokens, or the shell aliases (`--paper`, `--ink`, `--rust`, and so on) that map to them. Dark mode swaps the tokens on `:root`. Never hard-code a theme color in a component.

rules.name: The Fixed Ladder Rule
rules.body: Use only the semantic type tokens (`--pksx-type-caption` to `--pksx-type-display`). Raw font sizes fail the design-contract lint.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No `text-transform: uppercase` and no added letter-spacing. Labels are sentence case in the source. Words are at least 12px (Label).

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow label above a heading and no section numbers (01, 02, 03). The heading carries its own weight.

rules.name: The Mono Numerals Rule
rules.body: Numbers that a user compares (indexes, levels, stats, counts, IDs) use the mono family.

rules.name: The Zero Chrome Rule
rules.body: If a region repeats on every route, it is chrome. Remove it, or summon it.

rules.name: The One Surface Rule
rules.body: A panel, rail, Menu, or Takeover is the only card. Groups inside it have no fill, border, or shadow of their own; they separate by spacing, a heading, and at most a 1px Rule. Option lists are rows, not boxes.

rules.name: The Height Owns Density Rule
rules.body: Read height, never width, to decide how much room things get.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows say "this layer is above that one". Never use a shadow as a glow, a color, or decoration.

rules.name: The One Summoned Surface Rule
rules.body: At most one Menu or Takeover is visible, over one Backdrop.

dos: Do let Slot type tints and sprites carry the color. Keep chrome on Parchment, Cream Paper, and Ink.
Do use the semantic type tokens and the mono family for numbers.
Do size controls with `--pksx-control-height` or the small control token, and mark custom controls with `data-pksx-control-category`.
Do render sprites pixelated and unclipped at 78 to 92% of the Slot.
Do keep the 16px floor on every editable control.
Do show unavailable commands with a reason, not by hiding them.
Do use container queries for layout, and the Height Band for the one Short/Tall switch.
donts: Don't build dense PKHeX-style desktop forms. Put editing in a focused Takeover.
Don't reserve space for headers, tab bars, or status strips.
Don't use width, aspect, or orientation media queries in shipping code.
Don't use a second accent color for actions. Brass marks a source, not an action.
Don't use shadows as glows or color effects.
Don't show more than one Menu or Takeover at a time.
Don't use Nintendo, Game Freak, or The Pokemon Company marks, or look-alike official game UI.
Don't hard-code theme colors in components. Read the shared tokens.
Don't put a card inside a card, or a colored side stripe on a card, row, or field.
Don't uppercase or letter-space text, or set words below 12px.
Don't add an eyebrow label or section numbers above a heading.
